# Original asset provenance register

All seven tracked game illustrations (public/icon.svg, public/office.svg and public/offices/stage-1.svg through stage-5.svg) were authored as original SVGs in this project. Launcher raster images are generated by scripts/generate-icons.mjs from project-specific vector polygon coordinates, not downloaded images. No third-party photographic assets, fonts or sounds adopted. Lucide icons are runtime dependency material with generated package notices; the elapsed-time code adaptation has its separate MIT notice. This is the current repository authorship record, not a trademark clearance or transfer of rights. Final source and generated asset hashes are emitted by release-source and bundle audits. Owner must confirm project license and final brand/asset rights.
